purpose: Portable pin list for the local model runtime. Holds no machine path, token or weight. Every model is unfine-tuned for SAHAY labels and never feeds routing, the SVI, a band, D4 or a crisis decision.

models.purpose: Hindi, English and romanised Hinglish tokenisation and encoder representations; runtime and latency benchmarking only. Candidate base for a future SAHAY multi-label text classifier.
models.architecture: BertModel (BERT base: 12 layers, hidden 768, vocab 197285, max 512 positions); loaded without the MLM head
models.parameter_count_basis: encoder parameters without pooler or MLM head, counted after loading the pinned revision
models.claimed_languages: 17 Indian languages and their transliterated counterparts, including Hindi and English (upstream card)
models.expected_input: UTF-8 text; cased WordPiece; at most 512 tokens
models.integrity: per-file size plus upstream LFS SHA-256 for weights and Git blob SHA-1 for small files, all from the pinned revision

models.purpose: Comparison against MuRIL for multilingual tokenisation, latency and memory. Not a second production model.
models.architecture: XLMRobertaModel (12 layers, hidden 768, vocab 250002, max 514 positions); loaded without the MLM head
models.parameter_count_basis: encoder parameters without pooler or MLM head, counted after loading the pinned revision
models.claimed_languages: 94 language tags on the upstream card (100 languages in the paper), including Hindi and English
models.expected_input: UTF-8 text; SentencePiece; at most 512 tokens
models.integrity: per-file size plus upstream LFS SHA-256 for weights and Git blob SHA-1 for small files, all from the pinned revision

models.purpose: Local Hindi and English transcription (task=transcribe, never translate). Runtime operation only; no Hindi or domain accuracy is claimed without transcribed evaluation audio.
models.parameter_count_basis: safetensors parameter total reported for the pinned revision
models.claimed_languages: 99 language tags on the upstream card, including Hindi and English
